title: O For A Thousand Tongues (New)
lyrics_original: O for a thousand tongues to sing
The glories of my God and King,
My gracious Master and my God,
To spread through all the earth abroad
Jesus! the name that charms our fears,
He breaks the power of reigning sin,
His blood can make the foulest clean,
He speaks, and, listening to His voice,
Hear Him, ye deaf; His praise, ye dumb,
Ye blind, behold your Savior come,
And leap, ye lame, for joy. (x4)
Glory to God, and praise and love
By saints below and saints above,
The church in earth and heaven. (x4)
I felt my Lord's atoning blood
Me, me He loved, the Son of God,
For me, for me He died! (x4)
See all your sins on Jesus laid:
The Lamb of God was slain,
The Lamb of God was slain,
His soul was once an offering made
Saved is the sinner that believes
From crimes as great as mine. (x4)

bible_verses.english: Bless Yahweh, O my soul; all that is within me, bless his holy name.
My mouth shall speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, my gracious Master and King, I offer You my heart and my voice today. Even if I had a thousand tongues, I could never praise You enough for the endless grace You have shown me. Help me by Your Spirit to proclaim Your goodness and spread Your love wherever I go. May my life bring honor to Your holy name. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Our single voice often feels too small to express the vast goodness of Jesus, yet He delights in our heartfelt praise. This classic hymn calls us to join our voices with believers everywhere, declaring the triumphs of His grace. As we sing, we are invited not only to worship Him in quiet moments, but to carry the news of His love into all the world. Let your heart be filled today with a desire to make His glory known.
